findings: MEASURED, and it is the round's headline: the opening CANNOT BE FINISHED by a player. `Engine._titleApply('new')` — the path the title's `New` row takes — calls `censusBegin({})` with no options. `Census.spec.race` is only ever set by `census.observe(race)`, which is only ever called from `censusBegin` when `opts.race` is present. At `writ.race-observed` the census throws `race must be observed before the scene reaches the desk`. Every probe in the tree opens the scene with `censusBegin({race:'...'})`; the player's path supplies nothing. Proved node-side with tools/journey/census-newgame.mjs: the player's walk stops at writ.race-observed, the harness's walk completes, and the two differ by exactly one field.

The throw is CAUGHT by `_censusApplyPending()` and shown to the player as the scribe's refusal (`census_refused`), so this is a SOFT-LOCK with an engine error string presented as dialogue, not a crash.
